versions.changelog: v1.0.1: documentation pass. Adds the two refusal cases missing from the table (unknown fldCharType, digitally signed documents), records that the field inventory also hashes the revision-wrapper chain, and documents the LibreOffice component check for external verification. No code change.

v1.0.0: rewrite .docx body text while keeping Zotero citations live (still refreshable, restylable, bibliography regenerable). Refuses by default across 13 structural risk classes; field inventory hashes field code, display text, separate marker and the revision-wrapper chain so a citation cannot be swapped into w:moveFrom undetected. Run merging stops at every non-text anchor by exclusion rather than an allowlist. Also supports programmatic bibliography style switching. 67 self-tests plus LibreOffice/python-docx cross-verification.
